candidates.exact_span: A valid test for each species must be reported during each reporting period specified in PART I of this permit unless the permittee is performing a TRE which may increase the frequency of testing and reporting.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether each species requires a valid toxicity test each PART I reporting period—and whether a TRE increases that frequency—determines applicable monitoring obligations (B) and how to classify absent DMR biomonitoring results as not required versus missing evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: One set of biomonitoring data for each species is to be recorded on the DMR for each reporting period. Additional results are reported under the retest codes below.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of the required primary DMR biomonitoring set per species per period versus additional retest-coded results affects which monitoring outputs are obligatory (B) and whether missing or extra rows reflect unmet requirements or acceptable retest reporting (C).

candidates.exact_span: The permittee shall submit the results of each valid toxicity test on the subsequent monthly DMR for that reporting period as follows below. Submit retest information clearly marked as such with the following month's DMR. Only results of valid tests are to be reported on the DMR.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Timing of valid-test versus retest DMR submission and the restriction to valid tests on the DMR affect when monitoring evidence should exist (B) and whether absent or delayed entries represent conditional non-requirement, documented invalid tests, or inadequate evidence (C).

candidates.exact_span: For any test which fails, is considered invalid, or which is terminated early for any reason, the full report must be submitted for agency review.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether failed, invalid, or early-terminated tests trigger a separate full-report obligation changes how missing ordinary DMR numeric results should be classified versus documented no-data or other evidenced states (C).

candidates.exact_span: Enter a "1" if the No Observed Effect Concentration (NOEC) for survival is less than the critical dilution, otherwise enter a "0".
candidates.computation_change_reason: This binary reporting rule ties survival NOEC to the critical dilution threshold; interpreting whether that comparison is an enforceable numeric compliance test versus report-only coding changes whether reported 0/1 values are evaluated as limit exceedances (A).

candidates.exact_span: Report the NOEC value for survival
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether the reported NOEC is subject to numeric comparison against an enforceable limit such as critical dilution, or is report-only monitoring, affects applicability of discharge-limit evaluation for those measurements (A).

candidates.exact_span: Report the highest (critical dilution or control) Coefficient of Variation
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of whether the reported coefficient of variation and embedded critical-dilution reference establish an enforceable numeric limit or ancillary report-only data changes whether these values enter compliance comparison (A).

candidates.exact_span: (If required) Retest 1 – Enter a "1" if the NOEC for survival is less than the critical dilution, otherwise enter "0".
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether Retest 1 is required governs an additional monitoring obligation (B); the NOEC-versus-critical-dilution coding affects limit comparison if enforceable (A); and absent retest-coded results change missing-evidence classification when retests are or are not triggered (C).
